title: Billing and subscription
subject: Re: {original_subject}
body:
Hi{from_name_greeting},

Thanks for writing in about billing.

Ben is a subscription app with a free trial. You can see your plan, renewal date, and manage your subscription in the App Store under Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.

If something on a charge does not look right, a screenshot of the App Store receipt page helps us check it against what Apple shows on our side.

If you would like us to look into a specific charge, reply with the date and amount and we will follow up.

Kind regards,
Ben support
